title: Registration route has no direct request coverage
reasoning: The reviewed feature is the public registration route wired to RegisterView.as_view, but the included linked tests exercise unrelated text fetching, devotionals, fasts, email templates/tasks, and admin icon actions. None of the provided tests asserts that the register URL resolves, accepts the intended payload, rejects invalid input, or preserves expected anonymous/authentication behavior. Because this route crosses user-input and auth boundaries, regressions in URL wiring or registration API behavior could ship without a focused failure.
recommendation: Add focused tests for the registration endpoint covering URL resolution or POST through the test client, successful registration, validation failures, duplicate user/email handling if applicable, and expected anonymous access.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included context tests do not reference the register route, auth_register URL name, RegisterView, or registration request/response behavior.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a test module or extend an auth/user API test to POST to /hub/register/ or reverse('auth_register') with valid and invalid payloads and assert status codes, response shape, user creation, and duplicate handling.
minimumFixScope: Registration route/API tests only; no production code change is implied by this finding.
